Production Showcase Renders (1920×1080)
Empirical proof of the World Kit: assembled strictly using modular kit assets without bespoke filler geometry.

01 — Establishing Wide Angle (20mm)

Full 12m x 16m double-height facility view showing structural columns, mezzanine catwalk gantry, and the glowing geothermal compression reactor.

02 — Architectural Scale (28mm)

Low-angle perspective emphasizing monolithic brutalist concrete piers, overhead I-beams, and 4m vertical module transitions.

03 — Material & Detail Close-Up (50mm)

Focus on retro-industrial telemetry console, workbench vise, wall-mounted electrical junction box, and board-formed concrete aggregate.

04 — Hero Geothermal Compression Reactor (35mm)

Centerpiece focal asset featuring glowing cyan plasma containment window, hydraulic stabilizer pistons, manifold feeder pipes, and amber beacon.

05 — Sector 05: The Great Portal Hall (22mm Ultra-Wide)

Cavernous 16m × 24m × 8m subterranean chamber connecting via North Airlock. Features the 6.4m colossal hero Stargate reactor ring (WK_HERO_PORTAL_RING_A_01) with 9 chevron locking clamps, glyph rotor track, glowing cyan quantum event horizon, elevated central approach runway, and mezzanine dialing observation deck.

Production Modular Asset Vocabulary (34 GLB Assets)
All assets adhere to the WORLD DNA metric grid, 7 PBR material families, and engine-ready transforms. Includes Sector 04 Geothermal Core and Sector 05 Colossal Stargate Portal.
VIEW FULL RES CATALOG GRID (1960×2280)
WORLD DNA & MODULAR GRAMMAR SPECIFICATION
The canonical architectural and visual invariants governing Site-44.

VISUAL INVARIANTS

  • Grid Snap Law: Every structural asset snaps to the 4.0m, 2.0m, or 0.5m grid with bottom-center or modular edge anchors.
  • Utility Conduit Datum: All wall utility runs align at Z = 3.20m datum across adjacent modules with continuous flanges.
  • Load-Bearing Realism: Every vertical span terminates in load-bearing columns, wall piers, or gusset footings.
  • 7 Material Families: Concrete Brutalist, Heavy Steel Painted, Galvanized Grate, Reinforced Glass, Rubber Conduit, Emissive Cyan UI, Hazard Stripes.
  • Beveled Specular Edges: No raw 90° digital edges; weighted chamfers catch ambient highlights.
  • PBR Lighting Philosophy: Monochromatic cool subterranean cyan ambient fill punctuated by warm tungsten task lights and amber emergency beacons.

PRIMARY DELIVERABLES IN REPOSITORY

  • WORLD_KIT_MASTER.blend — Master Blender file with all 16 collections & materials.
  • WORLD_KIT_EXPORT/ — 34 individual production .glb models organized by category.
  • renders/showcase/ — 1080p raytraced stills, 360° panorama, and walkthrough MP4.
  • renders/catalog/ — 34 studio thumbnails & master visual catalog grid.
  • ASSET_MANIFEST.json & ASSET_MANIFEST.md — Dimensional and polygon audit.
